name: How should I prepare my kitchen before countertop installation day?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before countertop installation day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the installation crew arrives, clear all items completely off your existing countertops and empty the lower cabinets beneath the sink and cooktop areas. Ensure your new sink, faucet, and cooktop are on-site so installers can verify exact cutout dimensions. Clear a wide, unobstructed pathway from the entry door to the kitchen, and ensure pets and children are secured away from the work area during heavy slab transport.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all counters and lower sink cabinets, ensure your new sink and appliances are on-site for cutouts, and create a clear walking path from the entrance to your kitchen.
